newsitem.title: NIGERIA: SOCCER-NIGERIAN STRIKER UMAR TO MISS AFRICAN FINAL.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-NIGERIAN STRIKER UMAR TO MISS AFRICAN FINAL.

text.p: Key striker Kalu Umar of Nigeria's Shooting Stars will miss out on the African Champions' Cup final and the chance of becoming top scorer in the tournament because of a nagging knee injury.

Umar is training with the Nigerian side in the southwestern city of Ibadan ahead of Saturday's first leg of Africa's top club competition against Zamalek of Egypt, but is resigned to missing both that match and the second leg in Cairo on December 13.
"Naturally I feel disappointed that I'll miss the final," he said. "It also means I can't achieve my aim of becoming top scorer in the competition."

The former youth international scored five times in the first two rounds and is second-highest scorer behind Madagascan international Tsimba, who scored six goals for St Denis FC of the Reunion Islands.
Shooting Stars are bidding to become the first Nigerian side to lift the Champions' Cup. They lost to Zamalek in the 1984 final 3-0.
